published.source: PR #54 (client 70425: Judgement of Righteousness 42.9%, Champion of the Light 10 / 20 / 30%, Consecration 4.2% a tick; Seal of Righteousness spell power once per the tooltip; Concentration Aura; Human, 2026-10-16)

summary: The twist build for an Undead or Demon boss, with Purifying Power 2 and Exorcism and Holy Wrath cast on cooldown.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons, so here they add damage on top of the usual rotation. Purifying Power 2 makes both cooldowns a third shorter.
advantageShort: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only hit Undead and Demons, so they add damage here. Purifying Power 2 makes both cooldowns a third shorter.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3 s, Seal of Command at -1.5 s so the first swing gets the Echo
Consecration on cooldown while mana is at or above 20%
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Command up, swap to Seal of Righteousness in the last 1.5 s before a swing, and back to Command before the next swing (one swap per swing, down to 20% mana); Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only hit Undead and Demons, so this build is only for those bosses.
Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 32 spell power and 18 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
At 180 s: twisting is worth 126 DPS, Consecration 109, Holy Strike 99, Hammer of Wrath 29 (measured before client 70425).
Human is best since client 70425 (Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon), about 2 to 3 ahead of Undead (Touch of the Grave) at 180 s.
Only one 2% crit elixir per character. A second one (Mongoose) would add 14.9 DPS.
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the 50% weapon percent per client data. Not yet confirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date. Holding them to their level 30 trend would cost about 1.2%.

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once, per the 70425 tooltip (the proc spell itself has 0). The SoD-style double count (2 x 11%) would be about 46-51 DPS higher. The proc spell's 0 would be about 53-59 lower.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization applies to Holy seal damage (an Era sim choice, the client limits it to Physical). Removing it costs about 11.
Synthetic gear on the hybrid budget, with only the Justice Battlegear 2-piece active.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60 except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does.
